description: List content with pagination. Scope: `posts:read`. Args: post_type (default 'post'), status (default 'any'), search, per_page (≤100), page. Returns id/title/type/status/slug/link + total + has_more.

site.description: Site alias to target (e.g. "guns2ammo"). Omit when only one site is configured.
